title: cymbidium teretifolium
intro: Cymbidium teretifolium, commonly known as the Chinese Cymbidium, is a species of orchid native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Cymbidium teretifolium include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
